title: chore: analysis and transform stop importing each other
body: Analysis imported `should_proxy` from `3-transform/client/utils.js` and transform imported `check_graph_for_cycles` from `2-analyze/utils`. The graph search now lives in `compiler/utils`, `should_proxy` in `phases/scope.js` next to the bindings it reads. No behaviour change.
